notes: Build qualifiers are real now. 'Budget steflos build with no primed mods' used to return the same Primed-loaded one-shot as an unqualified ask; now budget / beginner / status / crit asks each return a distinct, validated card whose title says so (e.g. 'Steflos — Budget (no Primed mods)'). Library builds are adjusted with verified base-equivalent substitutions (Primed Point Blank → Point Blank, Primed Ravage → Ravage, Galvanized → base multishot) and the answer names every swap; when no library build fits the qualifier, the generator builds one under it.

Generated Warframe builds are derived from each frame's own kit (ability text + stats + its augment in the mods database): Saryn gets a caster core (strength stack, Primed Continuity, Stretch + Overextended for spore coverage, her augment), Wisp a support core (Umbral Intensify, duration, Primed Flow, Augur Message), Rhino a tank core — the shared Vitality/Steel Fiber/Intensify skeleton is gone. A status ask for the Kuva Zarr now returns a status-weighted build (dual 60/60 combos + flat status chance) instead of the crit one-shot, and generated weapon builds are always topped up to a full 8 mods (a status-leaning rifle previously came back with 5).

Every build answer (library, template, Steel Path frame, generated, qualified) now ends with the other verified builds for the same item from the 880-build library, so you can pick a different one instead of re-asking.
Build-card rendering hardened: the mod list is cleaned and checked before the card is built, so a card can never render as a title + Copy buttons with an empty mod grid.
Guardrails unchanged: every served build still passes the slot/real-mod validation (buildIsValid) and build intent still never reaches the free-chat model.

Build questions are now answered ONLY from verified data in every chat mode. The downloaded AI improvised a Steflos build with Corrosive Projection + Steel Charge (aura mods) on a shotgun, a wrong effect for Galvanized Hell, and invented farm sources — so build intent is routed to the Vault Guide's verified library before the AI ever sees it, and any build-shaped AI answer is validated against the mods database before it renders (slot validity + real mods); a failing answer is replaced by the verified one.

Full library audit (880 builds, tools/validate-builds.py added): 7 shotgun builds carried rifle-only mods (Serration, Galvanized Chamber, Vital Sense...) — rebuilt with the correct shotgun mods. Tenet Cycron's 'one-shot' build was 8 rifle mods on a pistol under a false 'equips rifle mods' premise — fully rewritten with real pistol mods. Tenet Arca Plasmor one-shot had 4 rifle mods — replaced. Kuva Zarr had a shotgun Cannonade mod — now Semi-Rifle Cannonade.
Aura mods in regular slots fixed: Protea Prime and Voruna builds carried Brief Respite inside the mod list — moved to the aura field where it belongs. Voruna gained Equilibrium as its 8th mod.

8 'boss killer' builds in builds-10 merged a full Warframe build + a full weapon build into one 16-mod list no single item can equip — split into proper paired entries (weapon keeps the original entry; the frame half is its own Warframe build; the two identical Rhino halves share one entry). Library: 878 -> 880 builds.

Duplicates removed: 5 same-item/same-mod-set pairs (Laetum, Pyrana Prime, Hate, Tenet Grigori, Saryn — merged with arcane folded in). builds.json was a stale 69-entry subset duplicating builds-0; it is now the canonical full library. Duplicate videos: none found (107 checked). Counters re-verified: 123 warframes / 648 weapons / 1,756 mods / 880 builds / 107 videos.

Text accuracy: the Steflos card claimed Viral while its mods (Contagious Spread + Shell Shock) make Corrosive, called Primed Ravage 'crit chance' (it is crit damage), mislabeled Contagious Spread a 60/60, and credited pellets on a slug weapon — all corrected. Same class of fix in Shedu (corrosive, not viral), Harmony, and the guide's build generator (melee Electric+Cold was labeled Corrosive — now Electric+Toxin; secondary Jolt+Scorch now correctly labeled Radiation). Viral's 10-stack multiplier corrected from 3.5x to +325% (4.25x) everywhere it was stated. 5 builds used shorthand arcane names ('Velocity') — expanded to full 'Arcane ...' names. 5 builds used 'Primed Bane of Grineer' with wrong casing vs the mods DB — normalized.

Guide brain fixes: it now loads all 11 build shards (it silently missed builds-10's 25 builds), and 'how do I make platinum?' no longer gets hijacked into a build answer by the word 'make'. Builds page now shows a build's Aura and Exilus slots in the detail view (the data was always there; the page hid it).

Verified clean (0 found): duplicate mods inside a build, aura fields on non-Warframe builds, empty/garbled build fields, duplicate YouTube videos, displayed counters (123/648/1,756 all match the data; the builds counter is live-counted).

Build answers from the Vault Guide now come as tidy build cards with Copy buttons. Tap 'Copy build' to copy the whole build as clean text — title, aura and exilus, mods in mod-screen order, arcanes, and the play note — and paste it anywhere: your notes, a message, or chat. 'Copy compact' gives a one-line version for quick sharing. Warframe itself only creates build links in-game, so there is no import code — the card lists the mods in order so slotting them in takes seconds.

Fixed the Vault Guide crash loop on iPhone: mobile Safari killed the page while the ~2GB on-device AI model was loading ('A problem repeatedly occurred'), the page reloaded, and the load restarted — forever. The full AI model no longer loads on iPhone/iPad or on devices without WebGPU; the guide runs there in quick-answer mode (live worldstate answers + the guide brain) with an honest status line saying so.
Questions never wait for the AI model anymore: if the engine isn't fully ready, the guide answers immediately instead of replying 'still loading'.

Fixed the chat panel vs the iOS keyboard: the panel now tracks the visual viewport, so with the keyboard up it resizes, the typing box stays visible, the newest message stays reachable, and page content no longer overlaps the chat.
Desktop is unchanged: the AI is still an explicit tap-to-download (~2GB, stated up front, persistent storage requested) and the v2.19.2 cache protections still keep site updates from wiping it.

Fixed the AI download loop: the site's update/cache cleaner was deleting EVERY cache on this origin — including the 'webllm' caches where the on-device AI keeps its ~2GB model — so every update (and every homepage self-heal) wiped the AI and the download started over. All cache cleaners (service worker, update flow, boot self-heal) now only delete the site's own 'foundry-' caches.
The AI download no longer starts by itself when you open the guide: it waits for your tap, states the ~2GB size first, and asks the browser for persistent storage so the model isn't evicted.

Honest AI status: the guide header now derives from a real on-device check — 'AI ready ✓', 'AI not downloaded', or 'AI unavailable on this device'. If the AI can't start after a try and one retry, the guide settles into quick-answer mode with a plain explanation instead of prompting the download again.
